elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

New workspace provisioning typically takes 10-15 business days due to infrastructure setup, security configuration, and budget approval requirements. Production workspaces require additional review and may take up to 20 business days. Plan accordingly!

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Workspace names must be unique - Check existing workspaces first to avoid conflicts
  • Production workspaces require manager and budget approval - start the process early
  • You'll need to complete required training before the workspace is activated
  • High-concurrency workspaces are more expensive - justify the need clearly
  • SQL warehouse workspaces are optimized for BI/analytics workloads - specify if that's your use case
  • Workspace provisioning includes initial admin access for the requester - you'll be the first admin
  • Consider whether you really need a new workspace or if an existing one could work - new workspaces have ongoing costs
